PreToolUse.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if ($env:COMMAND -match '(push.*--force|reset.*--hard|clean.*-fd)') { Write-Error '[GUARD] Destructive Git Operation Blocked'; exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"

PostToolUse.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host '[Hook] Edit recorded. Syntax and formatting preserved.'"
